column3: Hygiene appliances and water coolers are refilled and maintained on site. [#77](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-77)
The Group has repair and refurbishing units for certain products, such as mats, water fountains and washroom items. [#4757](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4757)
In France, Elis has a workshop that specializes in refurbishing its water fountains and hygiene appliances (dispensers, etc.). [#2710](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2710)
This is true in particular for segments such as soap, water fountains and paper. [#5209](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5209)

In this vein, the Group offers emulsion soap dispensers to reduce the amount of product used and make the rinsing stage easier, thereby also slashing water consumption. [#4488](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4488)

Water fountain bottles are also picked up during delivery trips and then returned to water suppliers, who clean them and then reuse them for subsequent deliveries. [#2761](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2761)
Designed for medical environments, the Victoria fountain offers enhanced hygiene with an elegant design. [#693](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-693)

Products that ensure good personal hygiene and help to protect the health of all The Group offers services that help to fight health and contamination risks, notably through soap and hand sanitizer dispensers. [#4901](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4901)
